newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end mixed, EDP strong.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end mixed, EDP strong.

text.p: 1655 GMT - Shares ended mixed to slightly weaker as traders took profits on some leading blue chips such as cement-maker Cimpor and Portugal Telecom, but the recently partially-privatised EDP-Electricidade de Portugal remained very strong.
*Traders said that the overall trend on Friday could be influenced by the dollar, whose slight weakness helped encourage profit-taking, together with the performance of EDP.

*EDP, which accounted for some 60 percent of the 39 billion ($224 million) turnover on the bourse, closed 4.4 percent higher at 3,392 escudos after hitting a high of 3,500. Traders said that 3,500 appeared to be a point of resistance after the meteoric climb of the past three sessions since its privatisation at 2,250 escudos.
*Traders said that individual Portuguese investors as well as foreigners were buyers of EDP on Thursday whereas previously non-residents had been more active on the sell side.
*"Tomorrow we are going to have to keep an eye on various things, the trend in foreign bourses and the dollar. But there is no doubt that EDP will be the volume leader yet again," said one trader.
*The PSI20 closed 0.22 percent down at 7,321.21 points. But the futures were again firmer.
